name: reconnect_resync
description: Channel drops and reconnects. After reconnect the SDK sends system::resync and the server replays state.

steps.note: Initial connection and session init; payload copied from runtime_bootstrap returned by /auth/token; session_id omitted on outbound system::init; SDK generates meta.client_msg_id
session_id: sess_abc123, seq: 1 — canonical bootstrap ack from SessionManager
session_id: sess_abc123 — message sent after system::opened and before channel drop
--- SDK enters RECONNECTING state; reconnect backoff fires after 1s ---
--- new WebSocket connection established; new JWT subprotocol handshake ---
session_id: sess_abc123 — SDK sends resync with last_seq=1 because system::opened was already received before the channel drop; server replays pending state
session_id: sess_abc123, seq: 2 — server replays the answer that was missed during the channel drop
